press_references.value: Ballerine joins Mastercard Engage to optimise merchant risk monitoring

partnership_announcements.description: Ballerine has joined the Mastercard Engage Partner Program to enhance real-time merchant risk monitoring. This partnership aims to optimize merchant onboarding, monitoring, and compliance for financial institutions, fintechs, and acquirers. The collaboration will leverage Ballerine's unified risk infrastructure to streamline KYB, fraud detection, and risk monitoring, enabling faster launches and reduced compliance exposure across multiple markets.

press_references.value: Ballerine Launches Trusted Agentic Commerce Governance Platform

product_launches.description: Ballerine launched its Trusted Agentic Commerce Governance Platform, a real-time operating solution that helps payment service providers and PayFacs prepare and govern merchants for agent-driven commerce with continuous policy controls and monitoring.

overview_description.description: Ballerine builds AI agents for financial crime and merchant risk that operate like experienced underwriters and fraud analysts. Our agents analyze KYB, web, and transaction data to detect fraud, uncover onboarding schemes, and monitor merchant risk across the lifecycle. Built for merchant acquirers and payment providers, Ballerine enables faster onboarding, more accurate decisions, and reduced manual work at scale. Ballerine is one of five solutions certified by Mastercard’s Merchant Monitoring Program, allowing clients to reduce scheme fines by up to 75% for merchants monitored through Ballerine

about_short_description.short_description: The GenAI platform that streamlines business onboarding, underwriting, and monitoring—fast, secure, and compliant.

product.name: Merchant Underwriting
product.description: AI-assisted merchant risk assessment that analyzes business data and policies to support faster, more consistent underwriting decisions.

product.name: Merchant Monitoring
product.description: Continuous monitoring of merchant websites, business activity, transactions, and risk signals to identify fraud, policy violations, and compliance issues.

product.name: Merchant Onboarding
product.description: Automated merchant onboarding and KYB workflows that collect business information and generate real-time merchant risk profiles.

product.name: Policy Fit
product.description: Acceptable-use-policy assessment that analyzes merchant activity and website content for policy violations and produces audit-ready findings.

product.name: Scam & Fraud API
product.description: An API for real-time detection of potentially fake merchants and other merchant-level fraud indicators using AI-based risk intelligence.

product.name: KYB & Ownership
product.description: Business verification and beneficial ownership analysis for identifying merchant entities, ultimate beneficial owners, and ownership relationships.
